newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila sees rice output at 11.3 mln tonnes in 96.
newsitem.headline: Manila sees rice output at 11.3 mln tonnes in 96.

text.p: The Philippines produced an estimated 11.3 million tonnes of unmilled rice last year, higher than the 10.5 million tonnes produced in 1995, National Food Authority deputy director Gregorio Tan said on Tuesday.
The latest estimate was slightly lower than the 11.5 million earlier projected for the year.
The increase on 1995 output was due to yield improvement and expansion in areas harvested, Tan told reporters.
Despite higher output, the country is expected to import 300,000 to 500,000 tonnes of rice in 1997 to meet growing demand, he said.
Tan did not say why the state agency lowered the earlier projection. - Manila newsroom 63 2 8418938 Fax 8176267
